There are a ton of places to look up beginner songs. There are a few sites that allow you to enter chords that you know and find songs that use those. Here are a couple of links:

  • http://deftdigits.com/tools/beginners-song-browser/
  • http://www.onchord.co.uk/search.php
  • http://www.hooktheory.com/trends

I would recommend listening to Nick Cave's The Boatman's Call; there's mostly piano songs on the album, but I had great fun learning them on guitar. Especially if you're interested in learning finger picking, there's some nice songs to learn there. People Ain't No Good and Brompton Oratory sounds really nice with regular strumming.

Also, I often like playing Cash's versions of songs from the American albums. Bridge Over Troubled Water and Father and Son are nice.

The White Stripes have some really simple, good sounding songs as well; many of them sounds good on the acoustic. Same Boy You've Always Known takes only A, D, C and G (+ some simple stuff in the bridge), and sounds really nice. :)
